description: This file is a header file (.h) for the BreeSpo component, part of the BSP Run-time Execution Engine (BREE). It declares function prototypes related to the creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization of the BreeSpo object used within a BroadWay Service Delivery System environment. The content primarily includes licensing information, comments, and function prototypes, but no function implementations.

methods.name: BreeCpoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the BREE Spo object, returning a handle to it.

methods.name: BreeCpoRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified BREE Spo object instance.

methods.name: BreeCpoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the BREE Spo instance.

methods.name: BreeCpoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the BREE Spo object instance.
